name: PowerKlock data API
usage: Plain HTTPS GET, JSON, no key. Cite the source of each dataset. Times are Paris delivery days unless stated.

datasets.title: Day-ahead prices · latest day
datasets.content: Every bidding zone: average, min, max, peak / off-peak, negative hours and the 96 quarter-hour prices of the latest delivery day.

datasets.title: Day-ahead prices · one day
datasets.content: Same content for any delivery day since 2015 (France) / 2020 (other zones).

datasets.title: Day-ahead prices · daily figures of a month
datasets.content: Per zone and day: average, min, max, negative hours.

datasets.title: Day-ahead prices · daily history
datasets.content: Per zone, every day: average, min, max, negative hours, peak / off-peak, rolling averages.

datasets.title: France day-ahead · quarter-hours of a year
datasets.content: 96 prices per day for a whole year.

datasets.title: Negative prices by month × hour
datasets.content: Per zone and year: hours with a negative price for each month and hour of the day, and the days counted.

datasets.title: France generation · quarter-hours of a month
datasets.content: Per day, 96 values (MW): nuclear, wind, solar, hydro (run-of-river, lakes, pumped storage), gas, coal, oil, bioenergy, consumption and its D-1 forecast, exchanges, CO₂ intensity.

datasets.title: France generation · daily statistics
datasets.content: Every day since 2015: average output by source, consumption min / max, CO₂, baseload and wind / solar / nuclear capture prices.

datasets.title: France solar and wind capture · daily sums
datasets.content: Per day: price sums and counts, solar and wind output and revenue, for all hours and for hours with a price > 0 — aggregate any window into capture prices and rates.

datasets.title: France M0 · CRE, estimate and forecast
datasets.content: CRE official M0 (annual, monthly base / wind / solar, contractual winter, negative steps, capacity reference), PowerKlock estimate with the CRE method for months not yet published, forecast for the next 14 months.
datasets.source: CRE open data (Licence Ouverte) and PowerKlock

datasets.title: Hydro reservoirs
datasets.content: Weekly stored energy (MWh) since 2015 for FR, CH, ES, PT, AT, IT, NO, SE, FI.

datasets.title: Installed capacity
datasets.content: Installed capacity by technology and year, per country.

datasets.title: European power map
datasets.content: Generation mix, CO₂, renewable share and cross-border flows per country, every hour of a day (last 10 days).

datasets.title: Cross-border flows
datasets.content: Physical flows on French borders, latest days.

charts.note: Every chart of the catalogue (☆ on the site) can be embedded in an iframe with its parameters; PNG images are refreshed twice a day with the default parameters.
